drug_interactions.title: Avoid macrolide antibiotics (Clarithromycin/Erythromycin) with Atorvastatin
drug_interactions.description: CYP3A4 inhibition can cause a 4-fold elevation in plasma statin levels, dramatically increasing the risk of rhabdomyolysis and acute nephrotoxicity. Use azithromycin or doxycycline if antibiotic therapy is required.
